title: Three Cities in One Day: Segovia, Ávila & Toledo from Madrid
description: Visit Segovia, Ávila, and Toledo—three cities that are UNESCO World Heritage Sites—on a full-day tour from Madrid that features ancient battlements, a soaring cathedral, a historic monastery, and more. Coordinated tours and transport make the most of your travel time so you can cover more ground without rushing to catch trains or find buses; traveling with a guide takes you straight to the three cities’ essential sights.

reviews.usertext:
Good way to highlight 3 cities in one trip. Some beautiful and amazing sights. Reasonably priced. Pick up and drop off clear. Expected English only tour based on booking but was mixed Spanish-English ( tour operator needs to be clearer in booking) Guide ( Diego) provided good history background

Avila was a bonus for us as we were not intending to go there. Bus ride was reasonable Meal needs work ~ appetizer and dessert okay but main meal rates as low. Microphone cutting in and out difficult to hear guide. There was a great photo opportunity on the way out of Avila that I would recommend the tour stop for 5-10 min just for picture It had a monument there which was noted by the guide but it also had a great view of the city

It would be nice to have had an itinerary for the day - transport time, time in cities, sights to be seen prior to the trip (ie attached to the booking)

At first I thought it was impossible but honestly I experienced so much in a day with each cities distinct beauty and history I fell in love with each one and opened my mind to adventures to stay longer in each city next time, which I could not even have known without this opportunity. Met a lot of ppl from different places while on the trip which made it all the more fun. Our tour guide was excellent , punctual and informative so we could get the most out of every city. I loved it and I highly recommend it if you want the most culture food and views of cities just outside Madrid for your trip which you would otherwise be oblivious to in one awesome day

This was a good taste to visit Segovia, Avila and Toledo. However, the bus was very cramped. I am 6 feet tall and could not sit front facing in the seat. I had to angle my legs into the aisle. Also, our guide, Majed, was rather impersonal. One would think that if you’re going to be spending 11 hours together that at some point, the tour guide would tell a little about himself and ask everyone where they are from. So while we enjoyed seeing the cities, it was really just a bus ride from stop to stop and a little history of each city in between.

My husband and I went on this tour yesterday and definitely wouldn’t recommend it for guest who only speak English.

Pros:
1) Getting to see highlights (very rushed) of 3 cities. Definitely don’t think Ávila had much to offer. I would recommend doing a two-city trip instead to Toledo and Segovia only because they both appeared to have more we wanted to see.
2) The bus had working A/C and select seats had USB ports to charge your devices.

Cons:
1) Our guide, Diego was very detailed with his tour information in Spanish, per my husband who speaks Spanish as his first language. However (I mean this in the most respectful way possible) his English pronunciation was very difficult to understand. I feel like I missed so much of the interesting historical details due to this issue. This was very frustrating as the tour language listed is “English”…not even bilingual so if nothing else…I wish I could have understood the English.
2) The included lunch was not worth it. Started with a vegetable soup, then a dry overcooked piece of steak (which hardly anyone in the tour ate) and 2.5 potato wedges, followed by dessert which was a berry cake and the best thing we were served. Still and carbonated water bottles were placed on the community table to share as well as 2 bottles of wine for our entire group which was 20 something people. If you want soft drinks or anything else, you have to pay extra.
3) You are on the bus for many hours and it’s definitely not comfortable enough for that length of journey. No bathroom on board so make sure you go at every stop. No foot rests to come down for added support. We left at 8am and returned at 7:30.

The tour was very rushed and allowed only a very short time in each city, specifically Toledo and Avila. Our tour guide, Juan Carlos was very unprofessional and rude. When we got lost on our way back to the bus he did not offer to come and find us or help us. When we finally got back to the bus he reprimanded us for being late. He did not give us a very knowledgeable history of each city, which he could’ve done during our drives in between each city.

The cities were beautiful but unfortunately we did not enjoy this tour due to this tour guide. The amount of information and what we saw on the tour did not match the price of the tour, which was too expensive for what we got in the end.

Other reviews of this tour with other guides were exceptional. Sadly this was not.

Majeed lead the tour very well and spoke very good English and Spanish and conducted the tour in both. He clearly specified the meeting points and times and the landmarks to find the way back to make the experience very stress free. He saved time by giving an introduction for each location just before we reached the destination which gave us that bit if extra time to roam about. Considering that we covered three locations in a day we did not feel too rushed. Overall he managed the day well.

As regards the tour itself, it does cover the main attractions for each location and is ideal if that's what you want and you're short on time (to see everything you could spend at least half a day at each location)- like a taster session. Lunch was good. The bus was comfortable and had working air-conditioning, and the driver was very experienced.

Overall, an recommended tour if you want to see the main attractions at all three locations in the same day.

Our guide, Juan Carlos was an exceptional tour guide. He was very knowledgeable and provided insight into the history of each city. The pace allowed us to see the highlight attractions in each city. Juan Carlos provided specific times for our group to meet. This helped us stay on schedule and see all the sites. There was a group of people within our group who were late to the initial departure point and who were also late to the bus at our first stop in Toledo (one of them had two armloads of shopping bags) when she returned to the bus. This group delayed the rest of us a total of an hour. Juan Carlos handled the matter very professionally. It is essential that all members of the group respect the others by being on time. I would highly recommend this tour if you want to see three Medieval cities in one day. Juan Carlos was an amazing guide who happens to take the best pictures to capture your memories of these magical places.

We took this tour knowing that we were going to cover a lot of ground and spend a good deal of time on the bus with a whistle stop of major historic sites at each location. As a result we were well prepared and were so pleased we did it. It was a little like the hop on hop off bus across three cities with some limited time to do your own thing. I would recommend this in the first day or so of your Madrid stay so you can catch a train or bus back to your favorite place and perhaps spend a whole day or stay over night. Alternatively it is a good way to pack a lot into a single day. Lunch was a bit of a let down given there were so many Spanish opportunities it was a little like an Aussie BBQ with Pumpkin soup and minute steak. This said we did not take the tour for the lunch. Well done to Juan Carlos, our tour guide on a balanced approach to the language delivery and sense of calm. Great job.

Super ‘touristy’ with a large group of 20 people and lots of time spent on board the coach. Guide seemed very uninterested in the tour/tour group, switched from broken English to Spanish quite regularly so was difficult to follow what he was saying about places/monuments.
Tour started at 8am and lunch was provided at 2:45pm so would definitely recommend bringing your own snacks. Few comments flying around about how hungry people were.
Definitely wasn’t the tour for us.

We had a wonderful time during the tour. The guide Carlos is really nice and gave us all necessary information very patiently. He also clicked pictures for us, which was very sweet of him.

All the three places we visited were great, but if I had to pick one, it would be Segovia.

The lunch which was included in the tour, was pretty nice and wholesome (even for the kids). We don't eat beef so they offered us chicken, which was again very sweet of them. So all in all, thumbs up to the team - Carlos and Antonio (the driver).

As a feedback to the team, I just want to say that since a lot of time during the trip is spent on the bus, a bus with slightly bigger leg room would be great. It got a bit uncomfortable in the longer runs.

On this tour the experience could have been better, we did not enter Avila, we only went to a restaurant called EL Lienzo, they took time serving (we were supposed to have almost no time) and they only gave us a piece of meat and three pieces of potato ( The meat looked bad) while the rest of the customers had typical dishes. The tour guide began in English and finished the explanation in Spanish and in the end he did not finish the idea. The distances between the 3 cities is more than 2 hours. I recommend two cities

The tour was great. We had enough time in each city considering we were doing three different cities located far apart. The guide was good and provided a lot of information during the driving so it wasn't dull. We made some great friends too. I wasn't expecting much from the lunch but was pleasantly surprised.

The van however was quite small and not enough leg room and the masks were not enforced while traveling in the van.

Overall a great experience!

Guide was very informative and friendly. He covered a lot of history of the 3 cities.
Suggestions to help improve the trip- Ride was not comfortable at all, 3 of the seats were facing against the traffic and facing the 3 other tourists- it made us dizzy and not good for sight seeing. Bathroom breaks, few minutes to visit souvenir shops and stores of each city will be nice if allotted in the trip. If seating arrangement is fixed and above suggestions are included, I will definitely recommend the trip.

We did not have much time in Madrid, so I booked this excursion. What a great way to see the countryside and some historical sites in Toledo, Avila and Segovia quickly and comfortably. Our guides, Juan Carlos, Ignacio and driver Martin were so great navigating us in a nice, new air-conditioned bus. Juan Carlos did the Spanish speaking and Ignacio shared a ton of information about each location for us in English. They also made sure that our time was maximized at each stop. I only have 2 complaints (hence the 4 stars instead of 5): Avila is the cutest village/town and you walk through pretty quickly passing lovely little bistros and stores, then you are directed to a "cafeteria" where you have a not so great lunch of hammered steak and potatoes. The bad lunch was saved by the wonderful company of our fellow travelers; trying out our Spanish and their English, great fun. My other complaint is they dropped us off in a parking garage and said it is around the corner from where they picked us up. This is not true. Grab a cab if you don’t know where you are. The garage was quite a trek from our hotel and by the time we realized it we were already committed to the long walk back to our hotel. It was super hot and my 77 year old mother had difficulty, so we were unfortunately late for our dinner reservation. I do highly recommend this activity there is a lot they pack into it. You will get a great appreciation of the history, geography and awesome photos to share with friends back home.

Loved the tour that visited 3 very interesting cities in one day from Madrid. You get a little time in each city to shop or get a coffee but the main purpose of this tour is to fit in 3 cities so it moves quickly through them. We feel though as if we did all that we wanted to do. Enrique and Diego were amazing! Comfortable transportation and very informative and guide that was extremely friendly and knowledgeable. This is a great tour to see more than you would on your own and great to get some insight and information as to what you’re actually looking at. Highly recommended! Be ready to walk and enjoy!

The reason for my 3 stars are as follows.

1. Please make lunch otional, the place where we had lunch was so bad! Worst in the trip
2. Instruct guides to speak 50-50 is english-spanish, not mostly in spanish when I paid for English tour guide.

The place sare beautiful, guide was helpful with a caveat.

A long day but we’ll worth it. Our guide ( I can’t recall his Syrian name, so I’ll go with Alfonso) gave us a wealth of information about each city and individual sites that we visited, by the way, allUNESCO Heritage sites. Great tour, great guide.

Great way to see the 3 most popular cities outside of Madrid in an efficient way. But there is not much time to explore any of them. The tour guide is kind and patient, but does not provide a substantial amount of description of the sites. All in all, I would recommend if you want to get a flavor of each place so that you can determine which of the cities you would like to go back to and explore in your own.

Took this tour from Madrid because we wanted to get an overview of the area with limited time. This was definitely the way to go.

Our guide Majed was awesome! He made it a great day.

Our driver Enrique was a very good driver. (The bus though, 0 stars. Not built for tall people)

Lunch was included and it was pretty good too. They did a good job of accommodating people with diet restrictions.

Terrible! They left us stranded because they didn’t have room in the bus to take us. So they just without remorse said they will refund within 7 days and drive off. We stood in the middle of the streets without any direction as to what to do.

The 3 cities in a day tour was incredible.
They have done a great job arranging the schedule as it is so that we were able to enjoy the entire trip. It is a hassle-free and very convenient. You don't have to worry about the transportation. Mini van was air-conditioned and comfortable for the day.
Our tour guide, Majed, was so informative and friendly. He is kind and has a good way of showing the tourist how to come back to the meeting point at each destination.
I definitely want to recommend this tour if you're enthusiastic about new experiences and taking great photos.

The tour was outstanding. Juan Carlos was our guide and Jorge was our driver. The bus was comfortable and the ride was smooth. Juan Carlos explained the history of each city right before arrival. He then took us on walking tours and pointed out the important historical and cultural features of each city. Lunch in Avila was in a beautiful restaurant with a view of the old wall. The food was excellent and the company was great. Juan Carlos was an excellent guide. He was extremely organized, knowledgeable and personable. We had so much fun and highly recommend this tour.

Majed is an amazing tour guide, with extensive knowledge of Spain culture and history. He is one of the best tourist guide we have ever met. He speaks fluent Spanish and English (I think he speaks like 7 languages). The tour was amazing, Majed and the friendly driver pick up the group in a luxury van (group of 10). We went to Toledo first (we did a street walk tour and then some free time), then to Avila (where we had a small walk and visited a cathedral + ate at a beautiful restaurant in front of the wall), and then Segovia (where we did a street walk tour and free time). Majed brought us to beautiful places to take pictures. We 100% recommend this tour and we are very grateful with Majed for this amazing experience!!

What a beautiful incursion in the medieval Spain - it was a fairytale coming to life. When we stopped in Segovia we were impressed by the Cathedral, the Aqueduct and the Alcazar, but later came the fortification of Avila. Then, when we thought nothing will impress us more, here comes Toledo with its spectacular views and its breath-taking cathedral. The stories Majed , our guide told us helped us to understand what a cultural and intellectual center Toledo was, with its multicultural approach.
Majed was a great guide, always explaining, telling stories, taking care of everyone, so a big Thank-you!

Majed was a great tour guide, his sunny disposition and knowledge was great. It did not feel long and boring at all. We learned so much and the bus was very comfortable, would recommend this tour as you really see a lot in one day! The sites were breathtaking

Loved the tour. Loved getting to experience all three cities. Loved the cathedral. The only part I was disappointed in was, I wanted to see the alcazar in Segovia. We walked fast and managed to turn the 10 minute walk into 8. Unfortunately, there was a long line to get into the alcazar and after waiting on line for a good ten minute we realized we weren’t going to get in, see it and make it back. The walls in Avila were impressive. The restaurant was a little disappointing for a vegetarian. I appreciated that our tour guide made sure myself, another vegetarian and another lady in our group who had dietary issues (didn’t eat dairy or beef) were accommodated. The restaurants choices for main were… lacking. Luckily we had the soup. We’ve traveled and been to quite a few cathedrals, including St. peters in rome, the cathedral in Toledo is probably my favorite and most impressive that we’ve been to. Our tour guide was very knowledgeable and did a great job, as well as our drive Enrique. We also have a tour guide in training with us who was also great. Would recommend the tour to others.

It was a let down. Signed up for a English speaking tour but it was 80% Spanish 20% English and even that we had trouble trying to comprehend what the guide was saying. This tour is a good way to see all 3 cities if you time crunched though. But if you don't understand Spanish just take note that you may not able to enjoy the whole experience.

I enjoyed our day tour of three places (Segovia, Avila and Toledo). I wish we had longer stay in Madrid area so we can get to enjoy each of those places, but the highlights tour that my group had was enough to get a taste of each of them. Our guide, Diego, was very knowledgeable of the history, spoke in both Spanish & English, very patient and professional during the tour. I recommend this tour if you have limited time in Madrid — spare a day to visit these places!

This tour is worth it! We traveled in a comfortable bus with tour guide Tamar who was very knowledgeable about the history of Spain. Our driver Jaime was a great driver and often offered himself to take pictures for us. We got to see the beautiful outskirts of the country. We visited Segovia, Avila and finished in Toledo. All three cities were amazing and full with rich history. We stopped mid day in Avila for a delicious meal. I would definitely book their services again!

Actually, my favorite part was how knowledgeable and interesting our tour guide was. Majed is extremely proud of Spain, it’s culture, the different experiences that have been present through Spanish history, etc. I had been to two of the three cities previously, so seeing Avila for the first time was wonderful. I will say, this is the perfect tour for someone who is on a short visit, with the traveler getting to experience the Crown Jewels briefly of each of these cities. If you have more time, you really would want a more in depth tour of each city. However, we were on a very short trip, and this was the perfect way to share my own love of Spain with one of my daughters. Nicely done!

The tour hit the highlights of all 3 cities and got you back to Madrid by 7pm. The bus was a proper tour bus, was sparkling clean, and had phone charging plugs. Majed was a fantastic guide and did a great job preparing everyone for what came next. Each time we got on the bus, he would give us history and then prepare us for what we were about to do/see. He was fantastically polite and kind and you could really feel that he wanted everyone to enjoy the day.

There were times when he was telling us history and I saw people walking by who were not on tours and I was so happy that I had a guide to teach me so much because some of them looked lost. I will definitely do another tour with him.

Our guide, Juan Carlos, was easy to understand, easy to connect with, and was knowledgeable of the vast amount of sightseeing we managed in one day. Our driver, Jorge, drove smoothly all the way, with no delay.

Positives: we saw three distinct cities and had many nice moments. Lunch was delicious; Segovia was the prettiest.

Negatives: Lots of roadtime meant not having very much time to explore each town — it’s a brisk but fun day. Every city leaves you wanting a little more.

With limited time in Madrid, I wanted to try to see the maximum number of historical landmarks in an efficient way. This excursion was the perfect way to do that! Our guide, Juan Carlos, and Enrique were so great in navigating us to 3 different cities. Juan Carlos shared a ton of historical information and context about each location. They also made sure that our time was maximized in each stop so that the most important landmarks can be seen. Plus, it doesn't hurt that you can take little naps in the car ride if needed too. I highly recommend this activity!

First off, this tour is amazing. With Tamar's knowledge and interaction with everyone, it made it fun! We learned a lot about the history and significance of each place we visited, We visited Segovia first, toured the castle, just make sure you have good and comfortable shoes since this is a walking tour. there are stairs too. Tamar would make sure we stopped at photo op sites and get the mandatory selfies or group photos. We stopped for lunch at Avila (included in the tour) and pretty tasty spanish offerings on the menu. our last stop was Toledo where we got to watch the sunset and see a wonderful historic city. Highly recommend this tour if you want to cover 3 cities and you don't have a lot of time to spend. Thanks again Tamar, we all started as strangers on this tour and ended the tour as friends!

I’ve been on a few tours in European countries and this was fine. I wouldn’t give it a raving review and I wouldn’t give it a bad review. If you’re the type of person that wants to check cities off on your list, then this is perfect. You won’t get immersed in the culture and you will hit all the major tourist spots. Our guide was very kind and gave good information. The bus rides were silent so you could take a nap. I think more information could have been given on the bus since the actual time in each place was so brief. (We had about 30 minutes free time in the two major cities.) in the past the guides I’ve had really attempted to connect with the group during the in between moments and I didn’t see much of that happening. That’s not a negative just a detail that I experienced. Overall it was just fine but I think the price was a bit high for the level of engagement and information.

Incredibly nice tour! Thanks to Carlos for re-arranging the schedule and had put me on other day as it was almost cancelled due to WEs tour guide having Covid. The company was quick and contacted me immediately! The tour was smoothly managed by Diego, young and vibrant with full of information and patience to our group. His also considerate with other members whenever they lost track of time and patiently waited. Kudos to the team of Diego and Carlos for carrying out an organized tour.

We visited three beautiful cities. The tour guide was excellent. He explained everything in English and Spanish. We were more than 20 people, and the group was fantastic. The bus is comfortable with air and sounds where you can hear your tour guide while he is explaining everything.

If you want to visit those places, please purchase the tour right now. The most valuable tour that I made.

Thanks to Felix (driver) and Diego (the tour guys).

We enjoyed the tour of the three cities - Segovia, Avila, and Toledo. Our guide, Majed Mezher, did a good job of explaining the history of the cities as well as moving the group along. We experienced enough of each city to get a taste of each and to learn which ones we wanted to visit again!

Amazing experience, really enjoyed the trip. We were able to walk inside the 3 cities and took pictures as well as listened to the guide Tamar who was amazing. They consistently went out of their way to make sure you were enjoying the trip. This is a must do in Spain. Also jesus the driver very attentive.

Tamara did a great job taking us on the tour. The weather was snowy but our driver Enrique took care to get us around safely. The pace is fast because there is so much to see.
Tamara explains in Spanish and English. There are beautiful sites with stops to take pictures. The cost of the entrance fee was covered, so you just walk into the various sites. Lunch was great with a view of Avila. Highly recommended to see so much in only one day. You couldn't do this yourself this cheaply and with so much insight to what you're seeing.

We had choosen this 3city tour to have an quick glance of what they provide. Tour operator Majeed and driver reki were cheerfil and helpful througgt the tour. An AC minivan was arranged with comfortable seating. They maintained the timings well at all places with a sneak peak into critical historical aspects. Food was prearranged and vegetarian option was available (but wouldn't rank the vegetarian food as great). Overall an historical trip to remember.

Hello, we are celebrating our 5th anniversary and this tours was way better than I expected timing works for our guide Diego he is great tour he was always ready to answer questions and was very well prepared and informed about the tour. I could do this again anytime.
Highly recommend.

Super cool I loved Segovia!!!

We had so much fun visiting all three places with Majed and Pedro. Majed really knows his history and makes a great story teller! There is so much to see and learn about in this one day trip but Majed makes sure that you know the importance of everything you’re seeing. Highly recommend this trip!

Excellent guide; loved this option to see 3 cities in one day which helped alot. The bus was very comfortable and it had USB ports to charge my phone, so that was a plus. Thank you for a great experience

The tour is well organized it started on time and ended on time. The small bus for the whole day transportation was comfortable and not over crowded which is plus. Our Guide Majed is very energetic, resourceful and provided excellent information and clues to come back to our bus.

This was an amazing day trip. All three cities were absolutely gorgeous. The lunch in Avila (steak, they did also offer alternative meals for those with dietary restrictions) was also phenomenal.

Majed was an excellent guide and very interesting and knowledgeable person. He gave great information about the history of all the cities we went to, is a great picture taker, and also gave a lot of good recommendations for things to do in Madrid and Barcelona after the tour. Pedro was a great driver as well.

Amazing trip! Toledo, Avila and Segovia are very beatiful and interesting cities. The food was awesome everywhere. We could enjoy every minute! At lunch we had typical food with wine and our guide Majed (WeMajed) was helpful, kind and very well informed!

My mom and I had a wonderful time on this trip, and we were surprised with how much you get to see in a short amount of time. Majed, our tour guide, was very knowledgeable and friendly! We would strongly recommend to request him if you book a tour through this company. He knew so much history and had many recommendations of food and drinks we could try during our free time. Our bus driver, Enrique, was a great safe driver. He was friendly and got us everywhere in a smooth timely manner. The lunch included was also delicious and we loved that it came with wine! Overall amazing experience with a small group and friendly professionals!

Tamar and Suso were amazing guides. I was the only english speaking person in the group and the guide was very patient in explaining the history of the places we visited in both Spanish and English. This tour is recommended for people with limited time in Madrid. The tour company are very helpful and attentive to details. They make sure that you have an enjoyable day. Highly recommended.

What a wonder to see three of Spain’s charming towns. Majed, the tour guide, kept us on track and made sure we saw what was important and best for pictures. His presentation was yo the point and informative. We were not able to see the inside or up close of the Alcazar of Segovia, and wish we did instead of St. Teresa at Avila. This is why we came to Madrid and we are so grateful

Excellent way to see a lot in a short time. We really enjoyed this tour. We were picked up in a comfortable van and were driven from Madrid to Toledo Avila and Segovia. Our driver and guide were excellent. (Enrique and Diego).
Definitely do this if you have time. It’s great to be able to see other cities of Spain and learn more about its rich history. And after a tiring time walking around you can nap in the Van while being driven back into Madrid.

A great tour that provides an overview of these three historic and beautiful cities. This is the perfect trip if you are short on time and want to experience as much as you can in a day. It’s also a great overview to help you decide where you might want to spend more time later. Be prepared for a lot of walking!
Our guide Jorge, was VERY knowledgeable, fun and engaging. I learned so much. He was patient with all questions and kept the tour lively and fun.

Paula, our guide was excellent. She pointed out points of interest, informed us of the sites with a brief historical overviews. It was an enjoyable and very informative tour. Our driver, Suso, added great humor and insights to our trip. His driving was excellent. Even napped between cities. Recommend this tour if you do not have a lot of time.

Exceptionally well organized and executed. Juan Carlos and Tito made a great team. Three amazing cities squeezed into one day. My suggestion would be to crate a Two cities Tour - Avila and Segovia and make Toledo a half day tour by itself.

I am grateful for having found We and was delighted with the service they provided. I was excited to go on this trip and the experience went beyond my expectations. The guide was friendly, knowledgeable and made me feel relaxed enough to forget about logistics and enjoy the ride! I highly recommend the agency and hope to come back to Spain soon to enjoy other experiences with them! Thank you for a fantastic day!

Our guide, Majed, was professional, friendly, and informative throughout the ~11-hour day. Everything was well organized and the destinations were fantastic! The drive times between the cities are great for seeing the changing terrain (or taking a much-needed nap after lunch!). We look forward to returning to Toledo especially as there was just so much to see and not enough time. Special thanks to the driver, Mercedes, for her excellent and safe driving.

Just finished out tour with Nacho. It was awesome! He was very knowledgeable and funny. Tour was a good pace. We thought we would be rushed, but Nacho was sure to show is all the best attractions. We did wish we had more time since there is so much to see in each city, but this tour is a great way to see all 3 cities in just one day if you don't have much time Madrid.

It was a long day but i enjoyed it alot. Segovia is my fave out of 3. Its well organized and i also enjoy the lunch break. Majed the tour guide is soo professional and very accomodating plus with a good sense of humor so i enjoyed his service. Overall i highly recommend this company and perfect if u have limited time in Madrid.

The guide was very nice but his English was good but not great. He spoke too fast as he was trying to squeeze too much into the tour. This caused his annunciation to be hard to understand at times.

He would walk ahead, talk to the ground and not wait to speak to the e tire group.

The bus was nice but a bit cramped for that many hours on a bus. We drive for a total of 4.25 hours.

We loved seeing all three cities in one day which was the time we had. If you have time plan to visit one or two cities in a day. You will get a better amount of time to see everything. It would have been helpful if our guide had allowed a bathroom break upon arriving to Toledo after the two hour drive. We rushed through the cathedral so my wife could find a bathroom. Not a pleasant use of her time.

You know this is going to be a long day but I must say it didn't seem rushed. There is a lot of travelling involved but we did get to see the main sites in each of the towns. Our guide, Nacho, was very helpful, knowledgeable and amusing. He kept the tour to schedule without being overbearing. Our driver was Suso who was very helpful throughout the entire day. I would recommend this tour if you have limited time in Madrid.

My husband and I went on this tour with Diego and Enrique. They did a great job of letting us know how the day would go, including the stops and the history at each. The lunch that was included was pretty good. It is a full day; if you want to do something shorter, I recommend Segovia.

Too packed. No free time. No guided walk in Toledo. Toledo is the biggest and most happening of the thee. Least time was spent in Toledo. Bathroom breaks were not timed well . Guide ( Tamara) was not communicative enough. Too much time spent on talking about what you can read on Wikipedia . I will not recommend this tour. Not worth the money. Lastly it was not twelve member team. There were 20 members packed in a mini van. Not comfortable at all.

Great trip. Covering a lot of territory and history. The mini bus was VERY comfortable. I'm not sure of the review wishing for Grey hound bus??
Schedule was easy, knowing it was long day. Beautiful. Food was.... Large group food, but what do you expect. Tamar and Enrique were helpful. The only disappointment was microphone on bus " not working" for first few hours. So no history or comments, just quiet time. The microphone was fine later in the day.

This is a fabulous day trip. It’s a lot of walking for those that like to walk. Diego was our tour guide. He is very nice and knowledgeable. We had a good size group (24) and everyone pretty much mingled with one another. Highly recommend.

Juan Carlos and Tito gave us a great tour of Toledo, Avila and Segovia. What could have seemed like a long boring day went by quickly and efficiently. The sites in the tour were amazing, but the logistics were very disappointing compared to other Tripadvisor excursions I’ve taken. The tour operator crammed 20 people into a small, hot mini-bus with tiny windows that fogged up — making it nearly impossible to see anything or take photos. Let’s just say it was an uncomfortable 12-hour day tour. There were no charging outlets on the bus, so make sure to bring your own phone charger. Every other non-Trip Advisor tour I took in Madrid or Barcelona provided a standard Greyhound-style bus — even for only four to five passengers. Furthermore, the Trip Advisor tour guide was different from the one mentioned in other reviews and was was not nearly as entertaining or informative as I expected from reading other reviews. A strike by farmers prevented us from going into Avila (another disappointment). While that’s not the fault of Trip Advisors, the fact that a well-organized protest that shut down the city came as a complete surprise upon arrival in Avila indicates the local tour operator isn’t on top of things to ensure the best-possible experience for guests. Definitely visit these three historic cities, but find another tour operator. You can probably find less expensive options that provide a better customer experience.

P.S. The TripAdvisor location in Mercado San Miguel is not the easiest to find. Make sure to scout out where you’re going in advance. We had to wait 15-20 minutes for a few stragglers to arrive, which caused us to get stuck in bad rush-hour traffic. More time on the mini-bus!!! Yay!

The food was also really good and was a lot (I saved some for later), they told us they picked it up from a local farm. I love to take tours when I go on vacation and this was one of the best tours that I have taken all over the world. Thank you!

I highly recommend this day trip. It was very organized from start to finish. I arrived at We Madrid fifteen minutes before departure where I met the tour guide Paula and the other five travelers. After introductions we hopped in an air conditioned minivan and headed to Avila.
When we arrived Paula was kind enough to let the group make a pit stop to grab some coffee and a snack before starting the tour. During the tour Paula did a really nice job of balancing the time between speaking in English and Spanish. She was very knowledgeable and pleasant.
We then headed to Segovia which has some of the most breathtaking views. After touring the city we were given lunch comprised of two sandwiches, one ham and one Spanish omelette, an apple, and a water bottle. We ate this lunch at a little picnic area that offered beverages for purchase. After lunch we were off to Toledo where we were each offered a sample of some cookies, a specialty from this city. There is much to see in Toledo with some lovely views as well.
Once back at We Madrid we capped the absolutely wonderful day tour off with a glass of Cava and some chocolates offered by Paula. We each tried to pick a favorite place visited from the tour which was extremely hard to do as each city offered so much to see or something unique or special.
Overall this trip was fantastic and really worth the money. I could not have asked for a more wonderful experience!

This was a really fun tour and Cristina was a great guide! We had plenty of stops to break up the long day. This tour lets you make the most out of a day. Every place we stopped at was amazing! I might suggest that the company update the featured photo. When I booked it, a visit to the Toledo monastery with the marzipan tasting made by the nuns was included. They changed the itinerary since, or at least they did the day I went, and you no longer visit the monastery. The marzipan is bought from a store in Toledo now. Was a bit disappointing, but overall still a great tour!

What an awesome way of seeing these sights! We had the best driver (thank you James) who started right off with some ice breaking humor. He did an excellent job giving us information on the drives that was very interesting. Paula, the actual guide through the cities also did an amazing job. The information was interesting but, not so much that you lose interest.

This was a memorable day for our family (parents and children aged 8 and 10) on holiday in Spain. Paula and Jaume were kind and knowledgable about the three cities we visited. Everything went smoothly. We would travel with them and this company again!
